hero.subtitle: Careers at Optixa
hero.title: Build the Future With Us
hero.description: We are a team of passionate engineers and designers. Join us in building high-performance software for the world's most innovative companies.

items.title: Accelerated Technical Growth
items.desc: Forget maintaining legacy 10-year-old codebases. Here, you will build greenfield projects using the latest stacks (Next.js, Go, Rust, AWS). You will learn more in your first 6 months here than you would in 2 years at a massive corporation.

items.title: Creative Freedom
items.desc: We don't micromanage. If you find a better architectural pattern or a faster way to solve a problem, we want you to implement it. We hire smart people and get out of their way.

items.title: Real Impact
items.desc: You aren't a cog in a machine. Your code will ship to production constantly, directly impacting our clients' businesses. You will see the immediate results of your engineering efforts.

items.title: Remote-First
items.desc: Work from anywhere. We care about your output, not your location.

items.title: Health Coverage
items.desc: Comprehensive medical benefits for you and your dependents.

items.title: Flexible Hours
items.desc: Set your own schedule as long as core team hours are met.

items.title: Top-Tier Gear
items.desc: MacBook Pro, 4K monitors, and whatever software you need to succeed.

items.title: Generous PTO
items.desc: Take the time you need to recharge. Burnout serves no one.

items.title: Learning Budget
items.desc: Annual stipend for courses, conferences, and certifications.

culture.title: No Egos. Just Engineering.
culture.description: We foster a culture of intense curiosity and mutual respect. The best idea wins, regardless of whose title is highest. We debate architecture passionately, write clean code, and celebrate our launches together.

steps.title: Introduction Call
steps.desc: A 30-minute chat to align on culture and expectations.

steps.title: Technical Screen
steps.desc: A practical pairing session. No whiteboard riddles.

steps.title: Architecture Chat
steps.desc: Discussing systems design with our lead engineers.

steps.title: Offer
steps.desc: We move fast and present a fair, transparent offer.

openPositions.title: Open Positions
openPositions.description: We are currently scaling our engineering teams, but do not have public listings available at this exact moment. Check back soon.

callout.title: Think you'd be a great fit anyway?
callout.description: We are always eager to meet exceptional Senior React/Next.js Engineers and Cloud Architects.
